posts.title: The Curse of Discipline
posts.description: The curse of discipline is that every day looks the same. The curse of indiscipline is that every year looks the same. That hits differently when you know what it feels like to promise yourself that next week, next month, or next year will be better. You mean it every time. Then the time comes, and you’re still making the same promise.
